Allahabad High Court Adjourns Bail Plea of Scribe Satyam Verma

The Allahabad High Court has adjourned the bail plea hearing for journalist Satyam Verma, who was arrested on April 17 in Lucknow. Verma was subsequently booked under the National Security Act (NSA) on May 13, alongside student activist Akriti Chaudhary. The court had previously indicated it might grant bail, but has now deferred the decision.
